integrity: Full proof and exact-rational active-set checker included; unindexed equivalent literature and independent validation remain unresolved.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the real finite metric-cycle Lipschitz-free norm ball with m unit edges and one strictly shorter exceptional integer length p>1 of matching parity; only facets and their sizes are classified, not the complete face lattice. The exact generic weighted-cycle Bier correspondence is prior literature.
title: Singular facet valleys at balanced lengths in weighted metric cycles
